name: reflection-writer
title: Write an essay, critique it, revise it

origin.source: LangGraph's Reflection tutorial (essay writer: generate <-> reflect loop), rebuilt as an explicit machine

comparison.purpose: A writer drafts an essay, a critic grades it in prose, and the feedback loops back into a revision until the critic is satisfied or the revision budget runs out.
